mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake, which can impair renal potassium excretion and increase serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal dysfunction or those taking concurrent potassium-elevating agents.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, especially in elderly patients or those with renal impairment; adjust potassium supplementation dosage accordingly and assess need for concurrent use.
